PM Modi Emphasizes Water Security, AI, and Public Awareness

Prime Minister Narendra Modi has called for a greater focus on water security, advocating for the adoption of water-saving technologies and learning from global best practices. He suggested promoting "Jal Utsav" to build public awareness around water conservation. The Prime Minister also stressed the importance of using Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based governance and continuous review in water management, encouraging a "Team India" approach to address water-related challenges.
